name: Mechanical Legs
body:
Aura moderate transmutation; CL 5th; Slot none; Price 7,500 gp; Weight —.

DESCRIPTION

These sleek metallic legs look something like the lower half of some alien full plate armor. They aid in speed and jumping. The legs increase the wearer’s base land speed by 10 feet as an enhancement bonus. In addition, they grant a +5 competence bonus on Acrobatics checks.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item, animate objects, longstrider, must have at least 5 ranks in Knowledge (engineering); Cost 3,750 gp.
